texts.preamble: M/S.Siva Sakthi Stores vs State Rep. By on 4 January, 2024 Author: Anita Sumanth Bench: Anita Sumanth 2024:Mhc:5638 W.P.No.36300 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 04.01.2024 Coram The Honourable Dr. Justice Anita Sumanth W.P.No.36300 of 2023 M/s.Siva Sakthi Stores rep. by its Proprietor T.Jayakumar .... Petitioner Vs 1. State Rep. by Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration Department, Director of Food Safety, Chennai. 2 . State Rep. by The District Collector, Coimbatore. 3. State Rep. by The Deputy Superintendent of Police, Coimbatore. 4. The Food Safety Officer, Corporation Central Zone Office Building, Hazur Road, Gopalapuram, Coimbatore 641 018. 5. The Sub-Inspector of Police, Methupalayam Police Station, Coimbatore. M/S.Siva Sakthi Stores vs State Rep. By on 4 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148271617/ 1 1/6 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.N .... Responde Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of Ind praying to issue a Writ of Mandamus directing the 1st respondent to open shop at No.19A/7, Vettai Thottam, Keeranatham Post, Coimbatore 641 035 For Petitioner : Mr.M.V.Bibin Mahen For Respondents : Mr.Vadivelu Deenadayalan Additional Government Pleader Order
texts.facts: 2. The petitioner claims to be the owner of a shop registered under the name and style of Siva Sakthi Stores at 19A/7, Vettai Thottam, Keeranatham Post, Coimbatore 641 035 (in short 'shop'/'shop in question'). There was an inspection of the shop in question by the Food Safety Officer, Coimbatore/R4 and Inspector of Police, Coimbatore/R5 and on 05.12.2023 at 6.00 p.m. The respondents are proceeded as though there were banned illegal tobacco products in the shop, whereas it is the case of the petitioner that, in fact, it is the respondents who have planted the tobacco products and that he is innocent. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.
